subject: gk
question: As per Union Budget 2020, the Government of India intends to double the country's milk processing capacity by the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2025**__

__
 
• **As per Union Budget 2020, the Government of India intends to double the country's milk processing capacity by the year 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The union** budget of India** is also known as the Annual Financial Statement in Article-112 of the Constitution of India.
 
• Department of Economic Affairs in the finance ministry is the nodal body responsible for producing a budget.
 
• It is presented by means of the Finance bill and appropriation bill to be passed by Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India is one of the largest milk producers in the world.
 
• As of 2021, Uttar Pradesh is the largest milk-producing state.
